description: Make the macro-goal save transactional. Replace the two non-transactional round-trips in saveMacroGoal (update is_active=false, then insert) with a single Postgres plpgsql RPC public.save_active_macro_goal that deactivates and inserts atomically server-side. Type the RPC in the strict Database type (no any), refactor the data layer to call client.rpc, and rewrite the save tests to mock rpc. getActiveMacroGoal and the hooks' public behavior stay unchanged. These sub-changes are tightly coupled and must land together to keep the suite green.
steps: Create apps/macros-web/supabase/migrations/0002_macro_goal_transactional_save.sql (append-only; do NOT edit 0001). Header documents run order (apply AFTER 0001 in the Supabase SQL editor) consistent with 0001's style. Define: create or replace function public.save_active_macro_goal(p_goal_type public.goal_type, p_tdee integer, p_calorie_target integer, p_protein_g integer, p_fat_g integer, p_carbs_g integer) returns public.macro_goals language plpgsql security invoker set search_path = ''. Body: declare v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_row public.macro_goals; raise exception if v_uid is null (authn required); update public.macro_goals set is_active = false where user_id = v_uid and is_active; insert into public.macro_goals (user_id, goal_type, tdee, calorie_target, protein_g, fat_g, carbs_g, is_active) values (v_uid, p_goal_type, p_tdee, p_calorie_target, p_protein_g, p_fat_g, p_carbs_g, true) returning * into v_row; return v_row. Add comments explaining atomic all-or-nothing rollback, auth.uid() ownership (client user_id NOT trusted), SECURITY INVOKER rationale, pinned search_path, and that the partial unique index remains the backstop.

In apps/macros-web/src/data/database.types.ts, replace public.Functions (currently Record<string, never>) with a precise typing: { save_active_macro_goal: { Args: { p_goal_type: GoalType; p_tdee: number; p_calorie_target: number; p_protein_g: number; p_fat_g: number; p_carbs_g: number }; Returns: Database['public']['Tables']['macro_goals']['Row'] } }. Keep Views as Record<string, never>. No any.

Refactor apps/macros-web/src/features/macro-goals/macroGoals.data.ts saveMacroGoal to a single call: const { data, error } = await client.rpc('save_active_macro_goal', { p_goal_type: input.goal_type, p_tdee: input.tdee, p_calorie_target: input.calorie_target, p_protein_g: input.protein_g, p_fat_g: input.fat_g, p_carbs_g: input.carbs_g }); if (error) throw toClearError('failed to save the macro goal', error); return data. Build a fresh args object (do NOT mutate input; do NOT send user_id or is_active). Keep signature (client, SaveMacroGoalInput) => Promise<MacroGoal>. Update the doc comment to describe the transactional RPC strategy and auth.uid() ownership. Keep toClearError and getActiveMacroGoal unchanged. No console.log.

Rewrite the saveMacroGoal portion of apps/macros-web/src/features/macro-goals/__tests__/macroGoals.data.test.ts: remove the mockSaverClient two-chain mock; add a mock that stubs client.rpc (vi.fn resolving { data, error }). Assert: (1) success returns the mapped MacroGoal; (2) rpc called once with 'save_active_macro_goal' and an args object equal to { p_goal_type, p_tdee, p_calorie_target, p_protein_g, p_fat_g, p_carbs_g } derived from input, and that it does NOT include user_id or is_active (ownership not sourced from the client); (3) input is not mutated and gains no is_active; (4) failure maps to a clear non-leaky error whose message contains 'save the macro goal' and does NOT contain RAW_DETAIL / 'leak-hint' / 'permission denied'. Keep the getActiveMacroGoal describe block and its mockGetterClient intact.

Confirm useSaveMacroGoal.test.tsx and saveGoalWiring.integration.test.tsx still pass unchanged (both fully mock ../macroGoals.data, so the internal rpc swap does not reach them). Only touch them if they reach into saveMacroGoal internals (they do not).
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run src/features/macro-goals passes with all suites green
npm run typecheck passes with the rpc fully typed and no any
npm run lint passes (no-console, no unused)

0002 SQL is self-consistent: SECURITY INVOKER, set search_path = '', ownership from auth.uid() with null-uid guard, deactivate-then-insert in one function body, returns the inserted row; 0001 is unchanged
saveMacroGoal keeps signature (client, SaveMacroGoalInput) => Promise<MacroGoal>; input is never mutated; getActiveMacroGoal unchanged
verification: cd apps/macros-web && npx vitest run src/features/macro-goals
Static review of 0002_macro_goal_transactional_save.sql for auth.uid() ownership, transactional rollback semantics, SECURITY INVOKER + pinned search_path, and partial unique index backstop
findings: Implemented all 4 files. (1) New append-only migration 0002_macro_goal_transactional_save.sql: create-or-replace plpgsql function public.save_active_macro_goal(p_goal_type, p_tdee, p_calorie_target, p_protein_g, p_fat_g, p_carbs_g) returns public.macro_goals, SECURITY INVOKER, set search_path='', derives owner from auth.uid() (raises errcode 28000 when null), deactivates active goals then inserts the new active row in one transaction, returns the inserted row. 0001 untouched. (2) database.types.ts: typed public.Functions.save_active_macro_goal with Args + Returns=macro_goals Row; Views kept Record<string,never>; no any. (3) macroGoals.data.ts: saveMacroGoal now a single client.rpc('save_active_macro_goal', {...}) call with a fresh args object built from input (no user_id/is_active, no mutation); signature and getActiveMacroGoal/toClearError unchanged; doc comment updated. (4) Rewrote only the saveMacroGoal describe block to mock client.rpc; getActiveMacroGoal block + mockGetterClient intact. useSaveMacroGoal.test.tsx and saveGoalWiring.integration.test.tsx stayed green unchanged (they mock the data module). Verification from apps/macros-web: `npx vitest run src/features/macro-goals` = 6 files/18 tests green; full `npx vitest run` = 36 files/204 tests green; `npm run typecheck` clean (no any); `npm run lint` clean (no-console). SQL validated statically only (no live Supabase in sandbox, expected). Did NOT commit/push per delegation (orchestrator handles that). Energy domain at repo-root src/features/energy/domain left untouched (orchestrator removes it).
